description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractModelAction' and multiple nested classes representing different action models for a widget framework. It includes methods for creating instances from XML elements, executing sub-actions, and various specific action implementations such as entity queries, property setting, scripting, and service invocation. The class is designed to be immutable and thread-safe, representing XML-based widget actions in the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: AbstractModelAction
classes.description: Abstract base class for widget action models, representing XML elements and providing factory methods for instantiation and execution of sub-actions.

classes.name: EntityAnd
classes.description: Models the 'entity-and' XML element, performs a combined entity query using a 'ByAndFinder'.

classes.name: EntityCondition
classes.description: Models the 'entity-condition' XML element, performs an entity query using a 'ByConditionFinder'.

classes.name: EntityOne
classes.description: Models the 'entity-one' XML element, performs a primary key entity lookup.

classes.name: GetRelated
classes.description: Models the 'get-related' XML element, retrieves related entity list based on a relation.

classes.name: GetRelatedOne
classes.description: Models the 'get-related-one' XML element, retrieves a single related entity.

classes.name: PropertyMap
classes.description: Models the 'property-map' XML element, loads resource bundles into a map.

classes.name: PropertyToField
classes.description: Models the 'property-to-field' XML element, sets a field value from properties or other sources.

classes.name: Script
classes.description: Models the 'script' XML element, executes a script or a simple method.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Models the 'service' XML element, invokes a service and stores the result.

classes.name: SetField
classes.description: Models the 'set' XML element, sets a field value from various sources, with optional type conversion.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new ModelAction instance based on the XML element's node name.

methods.name: readSubActions
methods.description: Reads and constructs a list of sub-actions from XML child elements.

methods.name: runSubActions
methods.description: Executes a list of sub-actions within a given context.
